scope: All 387 main-matrix boundaries for six reviewed generated/state-dependent target mappings, not all Material mappings or supplementary captures. No canonical input or renderer change. No automatic appearance/style attribution.

findings.evidence: 25 bottom-sheet-overlay and 34 snack-bar-overlay observations retain .cdk-global-overlay-wrapper {z-index:1000} at sheet:8/5/0 in the full tree, but not in scalar referenceAuthored. Computed scalar styles still agree with the selected tree node.
findings.history: 6948211 introduced matchedAuthoredStyles with recursion only for media/supports and a CSSStyleRule-only gate. Source-history evidence, not a historical runtime bisect.
findings.proof: tests/material-parity/input-tree-evidence.spec.mjs: captured Material scalar collector skips layer rules that full-tree capture retains
findings.limitation: The full-tree collector retains nested rule source paths but not explicit layer names/order metadata. It cannot by itself establish arbitrary cascade precedence.

findings.evidence: All eight tooltip/open profile-by-DPR cases have candidate scalar/tree popup presence and no reference scalar/tree popup. These are one-sided state observations, not eight additional missing-layer rules or an absent reference ID mapping.

implementationOrder: Repair original scalar CSS grouping-rule capture at the harness owner; retain relevant condition/layer provenance and explicit read errors. Add layer-specific precedence evidence before claiming cascade winners.
Rebind or recapture affected scalar inputs from trustworthy full-tree evidence with exact source provenance; never overwrite the frozen baseline or silently backfill authored input.

Use the verified generated/state owner mappings to extend property-level audit only after each property's complete guards pass. Motion/reset rules, inherited fonts, structure and final paint remain independent.
Keep the eight tooltip-open state mismatches linked to existing fixture and harness findings; do not delete the scenario or fabricate an HTML counterpart.

directRuleCoverageSweep.command: node --input-type=module -e "import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';import{createHash}from'node:crypto';import{isDeepStrictEqual as eq}from'node:util';const p=JSON.parse(readFileSync('artifacts/material-parity/current-ancestry-audit/latest-report.json')),cache=new Map(),gaps=[];let checked=0;for(const [kind,es]of[['static',p.results],['interaction',p.interactions]])for(const e of es){const ref=e.inputTrees.reference;if(!cache.has(ref.file)){const bytes=readFileSync(ref.file);if(createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex')!==ref.sha256)throw Error('tree hash mismatch');const t=JSON.parse(bytes);if(t.errors.length)throw Error('tree errors');cache.set(ref.file,t);}const t=cache.get(ref.file);for(const i of e.styleInputs){if(!i.reference)continue;const ns=t.nodes.filter(n=>(n.attributes?.['data-parity-id']??n.attributes?.id)===i.id);if(ns.length!==1)continue;checked++;for(const r of ns[0].rules.map(j=>t.rules[j]).filter(r=>r.active)){if(i.referenceAuthored.some(a=>a.selector===r.selector&&eq(a.declarations,r.declarations)))continue;gaps.push({case:kind+':'+e.family+'@'+e.profile+'/'+e.viewport.id+(e.state?'/'+e.state:''),id:i.id,source:r.source,selector:r.selector,declarations:r.declarations});}}}console.log(JSON.stringify({checked,verifiedReferenceTreeFiles:cache.size,missingActiveRules:gaps.length,gaps}));"
directRuleCoverageSweep.scope: All main-matrix uniquely ID-mapped reference scalar nodes, checking active captured rule presence only. Generated aliases, duplicate parity IDs, inline declarations, cascade ordering and output equivalence are not covered by this sweep.
